system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown-free tweeds and ulster, with Dr. Watson in frock-coat, standing with Helen Stoner in plain dark dress on the lawn before the manor","action":"Holmes gestures toward the boarded ruined wing while Watson listens and Helen Stoner clasps her hands, pale and attentive, as Holmes gives brisk instructions to move on","setting":"Grey lichen-stained stone manor at Stoke Moran, Surrey, ill-trimmed lawn in front, ruined wing boarded and scaffolded against the end wall","secondaryElements":"Scaffolding poles and planks against the end wall, a few weeds and tufts of grass on the lawn, the high central block and curving wings behind, Holmes's pipe in hand","mood":"Tense, restrained and quietly urgent, with gothic unease tempering Holmes's brisk resolve","timeOfDay":"Late morning, overcast daytime","composition":"Medium wide shot from the lawn, figures grouped in the lower left with the curving wings and ruined boarded block sweeping across the frame"}
